controlled_variable: direct lower-to-upper cross-layer input connection only
scientific_question: Does explicit vertical composition outperform parallel insertion when lower-head weights, upper-head initialization, objective, seed, and budget are held fixed?

fixed_conditions.training_recipe: train lower alone, freeze/copy identical lower weights into both arms, then train upper sequentially
fixed_conditions.zero_init: lower and upper alphas initialized exactly zero; cascade skip scale initialized exactly zero
fixed_conditions.generation_cache_mode: use_cache=False for inserted-head generation and behavioral evaluation

capability_corpus.contamination_control: uses only MMLU validation, ARC-Easy train, HellaSwag train; benchmark uses MMLU test, ARC-Easy test, HellaSwag validation
